A-slice padding and B packing change layouts and add work; earlier padding and packed-B results on other paths did not promote, which is caution rather than proof about this path. A transpose fusion has the largest workload and scheduling change. The A-transpose proposal only targets fallback sizes, outside the n=512 timing objective.
